Help guide

Everything you need to order with confidence — sizes, delivery, payment and exchanges.

🛍️ How to order — 4 steps

  1. Tap any product photo or name to open its full details, photos and size guide.
  2. Pick your size & quantity. For hoodies, L is +Rs 150, XL +Rs 300, XXL +Rs 450 on top of the base price.
  3. Add to Cart or Buy Now. Buy Now takes you straight to checkout.
  4. Fill name, mobile, email, city & full address, choose Cash on Delivery, JazzCash or Easypaisa, then place the order — or tap Send Order on WhatsApp to send the full order straight to us on WhatsApp. You will get an order confirmation code like UT-123456 on screen — keep it safe. Tap “Email my confirmation code” on the confirmation screen to open a pre-filled email to yourself with the code and order summary (automatic email from UrbanThread is coming as the next step).

📏 Choosing your size

Measure around the fullest part of your chest, in inches:

  • 38″ → S  •  40″ → M  •  42″ → L
  • 44″ → XL  •  46″ → XXL
  • Between sizes or like a relaxed fit? Go one size up.
  • For the belt, pick by waist size: 40, 42, 44, 46, 48 or 50.
  • Wallet & sunglasses are one size.

Tip: open any hoodie or T-shirt and its own size table is shown inside, with your selected size highlighted.

🚚 Delivery & payment

  • Delivery: Rs 250 flat anywhere in Pakistan. Free over Rs 5,000.
  • Dispatch: 1–2 working days from Islamabad. We call to confirm before dispatch.
  • Pay: Cash on Delivery at your door, or JazzCash / Easypaisa — we share the number on the confirmation call.
  • Exchange: Wrong size? 7-day exchange, unworn with tags on.
How do I place an order?

Tap any product to open it, pick your colour, size and quantity, then tap Buy Now (or Add to Cart and checkout from the cart). Fill in your name, mobile number, email, city and full address, choose Cash on Delivery, JazzCash or Easypaisa, and place the order. You can also tap the green Send Order on WhatsApp button at checkout to send the full order straight to us on WhatsApp. You will get an order confirmation code (e.g. UT-123456) on screen — keep it safe.

How do I see full product details and the size guide for one item?

Tap the product photo, product name, or “View details” button on any card. A detail view opens with a larger photo, full description, price with any large-size charge, the size table for that item, quantity picker, Add to Cart and Buy Now.

Why does the hoodie price change when I pick L, XL or XXL?

Large hoodie sizes cost more: L adds Rs 150, XL adds Rs 300 and XXL adds Rs 450 to the base price shown. S and M have no extra charge. T-shirts and accessories have no size surcharge. The final price is always shown before you add to cart and again in the cart.

How long does delivery take and how much is it?

Orders are dispatched from Islamabad in 1–2 working days and delivered nationwide. Delivery is Rs 250 flat, and free on orders of Rs 5,000 or more. We call your mobile to confirm before dispatch, so please double-check the number at checkout.

How can I pay?

Cash on Delivery — pay in cash when the rider arrives — or pay upfront by JazzCash or Easypaisa. If you choose JazzCash or Easypaisa, we call you to confirm and share the payment number before dispatch.

Can I exchange if the size is wrong?

Yes — 7-day easy size exchange on unworn items with tags on. Call or WhatsApp us on 03179369487 or email mursalshah496@gmail.com with your order number and the size you need, and we will arrange the swap.

I placed an order — what happens next?

You get an order confirmation code (for example UT-482910) shown prominently on screen, plus a copyable order summary that includes your name, phone, email, city and address. On that same screen, tap “Email my confirmation code” to open a pre-filled email addressed to the email you entered at checkout, from UrbanThread (mursalshah496@gmail.com), with your code and full order summary — just press Send in your mail app. Automatic email is the next step and isn’t switched on yet. Keep your code safe. We call the mobile number you gave to confirm, then dispatch in 1–2 working days. For any question, call or WhatsApp 03179369487 or email mursalshah496@gmail.com with your confirmation code.

How do the deals work?

Two savings work together: (1) Flash Sale prices are already cut on every card. (2) Add 2 or more items to your cart and 10% OFF is applied automatically — you will see “Buy 2+ deal” in the cart totals. Free delivery is checked after the discount: if your discounted total is Rs 5,000 or more, delivery is free — the green progress bar in the cart shows how close you are.

How do Wishlist, Search, Sort and Sharing work?

Tap the ♡ heart on any product to save it, then tap “♥ Wishlist” at the top to see only saved items. Use the Search box to find “hoodie”, “polo” or “wallet”, filter by Price and Size, and Sort by Popular, Top Rated, Price or Biggest Discount. Open any product to see its “You may also like” picks. To share, tap Share on a card or “Share on WhatsApp” inside the product — for Instagram, tap “Copy product details” and paste it in your Story, post or DM.

Still stuck?

Tap “Chat” at the bottom-right and ask the store assistant about sizes, prices, delivery, payment or exchanges — or tap “Ask the store assistant” at the top of this guide. You can also call or WhatsApp us on 03179369487 or email mursalshah496@gmail.com.
